Faint RGB/alpha residue remains; the blue diagnostic stays below alpha8.

sources.name: actions-s
sources.scope: opt-in Union A S stationary actions; exact historical Gettysburg v7 only
sources.annotationMethod: Separate model-assisted review of all four cells. Manual pelvis X and shared ground Y are uncertain by approximately ±5–8 native pixels. One 460 px stationary reference covers ready, fire, load and ram. Tube mouth (287,406), distinct from the blade tip, is uncertain by ±3–4 px.
limitations: Frontal fire projects chiefly south, approximately 86.4 degrees from screen-right. Shoulder, cheek and grips are plausible by model-assisted review, without anatomical certification.
Two representative loading states retain separate bore, rod and offset blade; foreshortening and occlusion limit exact weapon/drill reconstruction.
Requested size and translation edits changed untargeted details. The final source was reviewed and remeasured.
Minimum alpha64 padding is 29 px. Two alpha1 boundary pixels and faint colored residue remain unchanged.
One held firing pose lacks recoil/settling. Melee, casualties, true bearers and full-family/production/human/historical validation remain incomplete.

sources.name: actions-n
sources.scope: opt-in Confederate A N stationary actions; exact historical Gettysburg v7 only
sources.annotationMethod: Separate model-assisted all-four-cell review. Manual pelvis X and row-shared ground Y are uncertain by approximately ±5–8 native pixels. Cap/sole spans are diagnostics; one 375 px reference applies across ready, fire, load and ram. Actual tube mouth (285,195) is uncertain by ±4 px and distinct from the blade tip near (292,159).
limitations: Rear-facing fire is distinct from upright carry through its elbow, shoulder and stock-region relationships; the hidden foregrip, exact butt/cheek/sight contact and world axis are not recovered or certified.
Visible rear-axis landmark (291,250) to mouth (285,195) projects chiefly north, approximately −96.2 degrees; this is not a measured full stock-to-mouth world length.
Two representative loading states retain a separate working rod and fixed kit; occlusion limits exact bore, blade/socket and rod-insertion assessment.
The requested 75 percent reduction was not exactly achieved. Final source dimensions, poses and padding were remeasured; no exact edit-isolation claim.
Minimum solid padding is 24 px at alpha64. Neon red/yellow/green diagnostic residue remains at alpha2 or below, blue at alpha1; none reach alpha8. Native pixels remain unchanged.
Recoil/settling, melee, casualties, true bearers and other bearings/identities are absent. Full-family, production, human and historical validation remain false.
